'''Fight Arena''' is an intermediate [[quest]]. The quest is started south of [[Ardougne]] by the titular [[Fight Arena (location)|Fight Arena]] by talking to [[Lady Servil]].

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Lady Servil]] west of the [[Ardougne Monastery]], just outside the north-eastern corner of the [[Gnome Maze]].
|startmap = 2566,3199
|difficulty = Intermediate
|length = Short
|requirements = The ability to defeat level 44, 63 and 137 enemies (all can be [[safespot]]ted)
|items = *5 [[coins]] (for [[Khali brew]])
|recommended = *{{SCP|Combat|50|link=yes}}, [[combat equipment]] and some [[food]]
*Alternatively: [[Ranged]], [[Magic]] or a [[Halberd]] to safespot all enemies (all enemies attack with melee)
*Fast travel to [[Fight Arena (location)|Fight Arena]] to start the quest - [[Ardougne cloak]] 1-4 or [[fairy ring]] to {{fairycode|djp}} or [[Spirit tree]] to [[Battlefield]] or [[Ardougne Teleport]] or [[Captain Barnaby]]'s ship from [[Rimmington]] or [[Brimhaven]]
|kills = *[[Khazard scorpion]] ''(level 44)''
*[[Khazard ogre]] ''(level 63)''
*[[Bouncer]] ''(level 137)''
*[[General Khazard]] ''(level 142) - optional''
|description = The prosperous Servil family have been abducted by the infamous General Khazard. He plans to have the family battle for his entertainment in the Fight Arena.

Can you rescue the Servils before the tyrant has these innocent (not to mention wealthy) civilians slain?
|leagueRegion = <poem>
{{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} — location requirement
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Desert}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Kidnapping===
{{Needed|recommended=Combat equipment, preferably Ranged or Magic to utilise safespots}}
{{Map|2566,3199|align=left|r=5|height=240|width=240|mtype=square|caption=Location of quest start.}}
[[File:Lady Servil chathead.png|left]]
Head just south-west of the [[Ardougne Monastery]] and talk to [[Lady Servil]] by the north-east corner of the [[Tree Gnome Village (location)|Tree Gnome Village]] maze. She will explain that her family has been kidnapped by [[General Khazard]] and his group of mercenaries and forced to fight in their arena. The player will agree to help rescue them.

{{Map|2613,3190|mtype=pin|align=right|height=220|width=220|caption=The location of the chest containing the [[Khazard armour|armour]].}}
[[File:Fight Arena - Khazard armour chest.png|thumb|220px|The chest containing the [[Khazard armour|armour]].]]
Head east to a group of buildings located south of the [[Ardougne Monastery]]. In the most north-eastern house, search the chest to obtain [[Khazard armour]]. Equip both pieces and head south to the prison, which forms the south and east boundaries of the arena.

'''Note:''' Multiple sets of armour may be obtained using the [[drop trick]].

The guards will only let you into the prison wearing the Khazard armour. Once inside, do not remove it, or the guards will not speak to you. You can wear anything in any of the other slots.

===Staging a breakout===
{{Needed|5 coins}}
[[File:Khazard Guard chathead.png|left]]
[[Sammy Servil]] (the boy in the purple shirt) is located in the northernmost cell of the east wing of the prison. Ask him where the [[Khazard cell keys|cell keys]] are, and he will explain the Head Guard has them.

Head to the south-eastern corner of the jail and talk to the Head Guard by the staircase. He will mention his cravings for [[Khali brew]] and let it slip that last time he had too many, he fell asleep on the job.

Head to the bar found west of the western entrance to the jail, and purchase [[Khali brew]] from the [[Khazard barman]] for five [[coins]]. '''If there is no option to, you must finish the dialogue with the head guard.'''

Return to the head guard and give him the brew, and he will quickly get drunk, handing the player the keys when asked.

Ensure you have your [[combat]] [[equipment]] and prepare for three enemies you must fight in a row (all [[safespottable]]).

Use the keys on Sammy's prison door to free him and a cutscene will begin, in which Sammy enters the main arena in search of his father [[Justin Servil|Justin]], who is being attacked by a [[Khazard ogre]].

===The fights===
{{Instance}}

'''Note''': The [[dwarven multicannon]] cannot be set up in the arena.

'''Note:''' Throughout the fights, you may teleport out if you run into trouble. Speaking to the [[Khazard Guard]] by the door of the prison will take you back into the arena.

[[File:General Khazard chathead.png|left]]
You must kill the level 63 [[Khazard Ogre]] attacking Sammy's father. There is a very easy [[safespot]]
behind a nearby skeleton, whereby you may use [[Magic]], [[Ranged]] or a [[halberd]] for an easy fight. All of the following enemies use melee, so you can alternately use [[Protect from Melee]]. 

'''Note''': If a fight sequence does not initiate, speak to Justin in order to continue, '''but note that if the ogre has already spawned, a second one will appear if you talk to Justin.'''

After defeating the ogre, [[General Khazard]] will appear and order his guards to lock you away after suggesting that if you fight in his arena, he might let the Servils go. 

Talk to your cellmate [[Hengrad]], and after a brief conversation the guard will bring you back to the arena.

The second fight is with a level 44 non poisonous [[Khazard scorpion]]. Note that it will reach you quickly, so you should immediately run to the same safespot or activate [[Protect from Melee]].

[[File:Fight Arena - Fighting General Khazard.png|thumb|right|Fighting [[General Khazard]] with [[Magic]] using the [[safespot]].]]
After defeating the scorpion, Khazard will release [[Bouncer]] the level 137 hellhound. You will need high healing food if not using the safespot or [[Protect from Melee]] at a low level, but otherwise the strategy is the same.

After killing the hellhound, a level 142 [[General Khazard]] will vow to make you pay for killing his puppy, and then attack you. '''This fight is optional''', and the quest progresses the same if you leave now via the door (use its Quick-escape option to avoid needing to confirm you wish to leave). The same strategies as before are effective against the general.

Return to [[Lady Servil]] and she will tell you that her son and husband are safe and recovering at home.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

'''Waterfall Quest''' is an intermediate quest about a legendary treasure hidden somewhere in the [[Baxtorian Falls]]. The waterfall holds the history of the great elven [[King Baxtorian]] and his wife [[Glarial]].

==Details==
{{Quest details
|description = Investigate the death of elven leaders of old. Search for the elf King Baxtorian's tomb and discover the mysterious hidden treasure of the waterfall.
|start = Talk to [[Almera]] in her house north-east of [[Baxtorian Falls]].
|startmap = 2521,3497
|difficulty = Intermediate
|length = Short
|requirements = The ability to withstand and evade attacks from level 86 [[Fire Giant]]s and level 84 [[Moss Guardian]] without any equipment.
|items = * 6 [[Air rune]]s
* 6 [[Earth rune]]s
* 6 [[Water rune]]s
* [[Rope]]
|recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|25|link=yes}}
* 15 or more [[Hitpoints]] (to run past enemies safely)
* [[Food]]
* Fast travel to several locations
**[[Baxtorian Falls]] to start the quest, plus one additional trip - [[games necklace]] to [[Barbarian Outpost]], [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Barbarian Assault]], or [[skills necklace]] to [[Fishing Guild]]
**[[Tree Gnome Village (location)|Tree Gnome Village]] (1 trip) - [[Spirit tree]], [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|ciq}}, [[Ardougne cloak]] 1-4 to [[Ardougne Monastery]], [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Fishing Trawler]], or [[ring of dueling]] to [[Castle Wars]]
**[[Glarial's Tomb]] (1 trip) - [[skills necklace]] to [[Fishing Guild]], [[games necklace]] to [[Barbarian Outpost]], or [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Barbarian Assault]]
|ironman = [[File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png]] You must briefly visit Glarial's Tomb, which has [[Glarial's Tomb#Restricted items|significant item restrictions]].
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Desert}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Tirannwn}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
{{Map:Getting to Waterfall Dungeon}}
{{Clear}}
===Searching for treasure===
{{Needed|recommended=Fast travel to Tree Gnome Village and then a bank for the next section}}
[[File:Almera chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Start out by speaking to [[Almera]] in her house west of the [[Coal Trucks]] and north-east of the [[Baxtorian Falls]] (use the [[games necklace]] to teleport to Barbarian Outpost, and run south). She will tell you that she is worried about her son, [[Hudon]], who is on the opposite side of the river looking for treasure.
[[File:Waterfall Quest - Shipwrecked raft.png|thumb|220px|Hudon and the crashed boat.]]
She will request that you check on him. Exit Almera's house toward the river and board the [[Log raft (Waterfall Dungeon)|log raft]]; you will crash into a small island.

Talk to Hudon. You will tell him to come back to his mother, but he'll refuse, hoping to stay out and find treasure. When you ask if you can help, he rejects you, saying you will steal his loot. '''Finish all the dialogue or the book will not spawn in the next part'''.

Swim to the south and you will be sent downstream, washing ashore near a large building with a fisherman outside of it. Upstairs in the building, search the southernmost [[bookcase (Waterfall Quest)|bookcase]] on the eastern wall to find a book named [[book on Baxtorian]]. '''Read the book''' or the key will not appear for the next part.

You will discover that [[Lord Baxtorian Cadarn|Baxtorian]] and [[Glarial]] were elven, and read about the legend of treasure under the falls. You will also learn that [[Glarial's pebble]] can be found under [[Tree Gnome Village (location)|Tree Gnome Village]], which will give you access to her tomb.

===Glarial's Pebble===
{{Needed|recommended=[[food]] and [[armour]]}}
[[File:Glarial's pebble detail.png|left|frameless|80px]]
{{Map|x:2533,y:3155|x:2545,y:3155|x:2545,y:3148|x:2542,y:3148|x:2542,y:3150|x:2539,y:3150|x:2539,y:3145|x:2549,y:3145|x:2549,y:3156|x:2551,y:3156|x:2551,y:3159|x:2545,y:3159|x:2545,y:3165|x:2550,y:3165|x:2550,y:3175|x:2544,y:3175|x:2544,y:3177|x:2533,y:3177|x:2533,y:3179|x:2531,y:3179|x:2531,y:3177|x:2529,y:3177|x:2529,y:3179|x:2527,y:3179|x:2527,y:3177|x:2514,y:3177|x:2514,y:3179|x:2521,y:3179|x:2521,y:3184|x:2524,y:3184|x:2524,y:3181|x:2529,y:3181|x:2529,y:3182|x:2532,y:3182|x:2532,y:3188|x:2511,y:3188|x:2511,y:3191|x:2503,y:3191|mtype=line|align=right|height=250|width=250|caption=Follow the line to find the Dungeon.}}

Head to the [[Tree Gnome Village (location)|Tree Gnome Village]] south-west of Ardougne. If you have previously started or completed the [[Tree Gnome Village]] quest, you may follow [[Elkoy]] through the maze, or use the [[Spirit Tree]] from the [[Grand Exchange]] to reach the centre (if it was completed).

'''Note:''' It is recommended to start the Tree Gnome Village quest now by talking to [[King Bolren]] in the centre of the maze, which will allow you to follow [[Elkoy]] through the maze in the future.

If you have not begun [[Tree Gnome Village]] you will have to navigate through the maze. You should find a ladder in the hedge maze. Very low level players should exercise caution due to the [[hobgoblin]]s within. Climb down the ladder, and find [[Key (Gnome Village Dungeon)|the key]] in the east room. The key is in the slightly differently-coloured [[Crate (Tree Gnome Village Dungeon)|crate]] next to the two crates stacked on top of each other in the south-east corner. In the west room, you will find a gnome called [[Golrie]] locked away. Use your key on the door, then speak to the gnome to receive [[Glarial's pebble]].

'''Note:''' You can use the [[drop trick]] to obtain multiple pebbles, which is highly recommended for low level players in case you die during the next steps. You will also save some time in the future by keeping your pebble after the quest if you plan to complete [[Roving Elves]].

Once you've started Tree Gnome Village, you can exit the maze by following [[Elkoy]].

===Tomb Raiding===
{{Needed|[[Glarial's pebble]], two free inventory slots|recommended=Food, a fast travel method to a bank and Baxtorian Falls for the next section}}
[[File:Glarial's tombstone.png|thumb|left|80px|Glarial's tombstone]]
{{Map|name=Glarial's Tombstone|x:2558,y:3445|plane=0|r=4|mapID=0|mtype=square|align=right|height=220|width=220|caption=Glarial's tomb location}}

[[Glarial's Tomb]] has significant restrictions on items you can equip or carry, so it is strongly recommended to bank any prohibited items before travelling to it. Notable restrictions include [[weapons]], [[armour]] (including capes), [[runes]], [[arrows]], and any type of [[Woodcutting#Logs|logs]]. All [[jewellery]] is allowed, so you may choose to bring [[enchanted jewellery]] for transportation (i.e. [[games necklace]] or [[ring of dueling]]) or defence bonuses (i.e. [[amulet of glory]], [[combat bracelet]], or [[steel ring]]). See [[Glarial's Tomb#Restricted items]] for a full list of restricted items. Bring [[food]] with you, as you will need to run past high level monsters.

Head just south-east of [[Baxtorian Falls]] and just north-west of the [[Fishing Guild]] to find a tombstone, and use the pebble on it to enter. Inside, there are high-level monsters that you will need to pass. One strategy is to attack a lower level [[skeleton]] or [[Zombie (common)|zombie]], as the area is single combat and this will prevent  the more dangerous [[Moss Guardian]] attacking you, which has a max hit of 14.

Run to the west part of the cave, past the level 84 moss guardians, and search the chest to get [[Glarial's amulet]]. Then head to the south part of the cave and search the coffin to get [[Glarial's urn]]. '''Note that you will be unable to perform actions while searching the coffin but can be attacked, so beware!'''

'''Note''': You can get multiples of both items using the [[drop trick]], which is advised for low levels as you can die in the next section.


Once you have '''both items''', you can exit the tomb by going up the ladder.

===The Chalice of Eternity===
{{Needed|[[Rope]], 6 [[Air rune]]s, 6 [[water rune]]s, 6 [[earth rune]]s, [[Glarial's urn]], [[Glarial's amulet]], 5 free inventory slots|recommended= [[armour]], [[food]], [[weapon]] if killing a Fire Giant for a diary task, fast travel method out after quest completion}}

Go back to [[Almera]]'s house and board the raft. You will crash again. '''Do not swim or interact with the tree without the rope!''' Use your '''rope''' on the large grey rock on the small patch of land just downstream, then use the '''rope''' on the dead tree that you can climb. When you reach the doors at the waterfall ledge, go inside.

{{Map:Waterfall Dungeon}}
[[File:Waterfall dungeon crate.png|300px|thumb|right|Location of the crate with the key.]]
Take the eastern passage first, running past the level 52 [[Shadow spider]]s, level 45 [[Skeleton]]s and level 16 [[Skeleton Mage]]s to search the '''northernmost''' [[Crate (Waterfall Dungeon)|crate]] for [[A key (Waterfall Dungeon)|a key]].

Once you have the key, take the western passage, then head north past the level 86 [[Fire Giant]]s and pass through the doors until you reach the chalice room. As this is a single combat area, may choose to attack a shadow spider so that the higher levelled giants will be unable to attack you.

'''Tip:''' Killing a Fire Giant here will complete a medium [[Kandarin Diary]] task (not recommended for lower level players).

[[File:Chalice of Eternity.png|100px|thumb|right|The Chalice of Eternity.]]

{{Color|Red|Warning:}} Follow the next part carefully. If done incorrectly you will either be washed from the final room, or take up to 20 damage if you do not place the runes correctly.

Inside the next room, you will find six pillars, two statues, and a [[Chalice of Eternity|chalice]] trophy. Use an [[air rune]], a [[water rune]], and an [[earth rune]] on one pillar, then do the same for the other five. Use Glarial's amulet on the '''Statue of Glarial''', and then use Glarial's urn on the '''Chalice of Eternity''', '''completing the dialogue'''. Take the reward (note that you must have five free slots to accept it) from the chalice after the ground rises up to it to finish! {{Color|Red|Warning:}} any items you drop inside the chamber with the six pillars will be unretrievable once you use Glarial's amulet with the statue. Make sure to drop any items you want to recover outside the chamber by crossing the door.

If you do get flushed out, or leave, the pillars will remain active. However, you will need to retrieve another amulet to re-enter the dungeon.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

The Grand Tree.content:
{{External|rs|rsc=Grand tree}} {{Otheruses|the quest|the location|Grand Tree}} {{Has quick guide}} {{Infobox Quest |name = The Grand Tree |number = 40 |image = [[File:The Grand Tree.png|300px]] |release = [[12 December]] [[2002]] |update = Agility skill online |members = Yes |series = [[Quests/Series#Gnome|Gnome]], #1 |developer = [[Mod Tom|Tom W]] }} '''The Grand Tree''' is a [[gnome]] [[quest]] centred on protecting the [[Grand Tree]] from dying upon the gnome race. ==Details== {{Quest details |start = Talk to [[King Narnode Shareen]] in the [[Grand Tree]]. |startmap = 2466,3495 |difficulty = Intermediate |description = The [[Grand Tree]], which shelters the majority of the small gnome population of Gielinor, is dying. Is it human sabotage or an inside job? Help [[King Shareen]] to find the true cause and save the tree gnomes from an uncertain fate. |length = Medium |requirements = * {{SCP|Agility|25|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} {{Questreqstart|no}} * The ability to defeat a level 172 [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|Black demon]] (safespottable for Ranged and Magic or melee using a [[halberd]]). |items = * 1,000 [[coins]] if you previously chose not to help [[Femi]] on your first entry to the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]] (not required if you never used the gate entrance) |recommended = *{{SCP|Combat|50|link=yes}} *[[Stamina potion|Stamina]] or [[energy potions]] *[[Combat equipment]] to defeat a level 172 [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|Black demon]], [[Magic]] recommended *Fast travel to several locations: **[[Tree Gnome Stronghold]] to start the quest, plus 2 additional trips - [[spirit tree]] from [[Grand Exchange]] or [[Battlefield]], [[slayer ring]] to the [[Stronghold Slayer Cave]], [[Balloon Transport System]], or [[necklace of passage]] to the [[Outpost]] **[[Hazelmere]]'s house (1 trip) - [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|cls}}, [[Watchtower Teleport]], [[Teleport to House]] (Yanille), [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Nightmare Zone]] or [[Fishing Trawler]], [[Ardougne cloak]] 1-4 to [[Ardougne Monastery]], or [[ring of dueling]] to [[Castle Wars]] |kills = * [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|Black demon]] ''(level 172)'' (can be safespotted) |leagueRegion = Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest }} ==Walkthrough== ===The dying tree=== {{Needed|recommended=Fast travel to Hazelmere and Tree Gnome Stronghold}} [[File:King Narnode Shareen chathead.png|left|frameless]] {{Map|x=2678|y=3086|plane=1|r=2|mtype=square|width=220|height=220|align=right|caption=Hazelmere's house on the map.}} Ensure you have two free inventory slots, then speak to [[King Narnode Shareen]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the [[Grand Tree]]. He will take you underground to show you the roots of the tree, which appear to be dying. He will give you a [[translation book]] and a [[bark sample]] and ask you to take the sample to [[Hazelmere]], the last surviving gnome mage involved in creating the tree. [[Hazelmere]] is found on a small island east of [[Yanille]], upstairs in his house. There are [[jungle spider]]s (level 44) on the way, although they are not [[poison]]ous. Talk to [[Hazelmere]], who will take your [[bark sample]], and after examining it, give you a [[Hazelmere's scroll|message]] written in his language. Return to King Narnode in the [[Grand Tree]], who will ask what the translation is. The correct translation can be deciphered using the [[translation book]] and reads: {{quote|A man came to me with the King's seal.
I gave the man [[Daconia stone|Daconia rocks]].
And Daconia rocks will kill the tree!}} Give him the correct translation from the options offered, selecting none of the above for the first two choices. {{Chat option|1I think so.|5None of the above.|5None of the above.|2A man came to me with the King's seal.|1I gave the man Daconia rocks.|4And Daconia rocks will kill the tree!}} The king will exclaim that someone must have forged his seal to obtain the [[Daconia rock]]s, which were made as a "fail-safe" and are the only thing that can kill the tree. He will direct you to talk to [[Glough]], his head tree guardian. ===Charlie the prisoner=== {{Needed|1,000 [[coins]] (if you haven't helped [[Femi]])|recommended=Fast travel to Tree Gnome Stronghold}} {{Map|x=2477|y=3463|r=3|width=220|height=220|mtype=square|align=right|caption=Glough's house location.}} [[File:Glough chathead.png|left|frameless]] Glough is located in a treehouse south of the [[Grand Tree]], east of the ramp by the hot air balloon. After remarking that humans can't be trusted, he will tell you that he will take care of the problem. Return to [[King Narnode Shareen]], who informs you that [[Glough]] has caught and imprisoned a human found with the [[Daconia rock]]s. [[File:The Grand Tree - Talking to Charlie.png|thumb|left|220px|Talking to Charlie.]] Head to the top floor to speak with [[Charlie (prisoner)|Charlie]] the prisoner. He tells you that Glough paid him to retrieve the rocks from Hazelmere. He doesn't know what Glough is up to, but suggests you search Glough's house for evidence. Go to Glough's house and search the [[cupboard (The Grand Tree)|cupboard]] to find his [[Glough's journal|journal]], which describes how he plans to convince the tree gnomes that humans are naturally evil and must be destroyed. Confront Glough, who calls a guard over to lock you in the cell next to Charlie's. Talk to Charlie, who mentions he delivered a large amount of gold to the [[Shipyard (Karamja)|shipyard]] on [[Karamja]]. He suggests you give the foreman there a visit to covertly see if he knows what Glough is up to, and gives you the password to access it, which is '''Ka-Lu-Min'''. [[King Shareen|The king]] will appear and apologise for Glough imprisoning you. He will tell you that guards are watching the entrances, and tells you to quickly escape on the [[Gnome glider]] on the top floor of the [[Grand Tree]], next to the cells. Talk to the pilot. He will ask you where you want to go and you will ask him to fly you to [[Karamja]]. {{Clear|left}} ===Karamja investigation=== [[File:Foreman chathead.png|80px|left|frameless]] The glider will crash land just west of the [[Shipyard (Karamja)|Shipyard]]. Run east, avoiding the [[aggressive]] level 53 [[jogre]]s, and attempt to open the gate to the Shipyard. A [[shipyard worker]] will stop you; tell him Glough sent you, then give him the password '''Ka-Lu-Min'''. Once inside, find the level 23 [[foreman]] on the southern docks. You may either kill him or talk to him to receive a [[lumber order]]. If you choose to talk to him, tell him Glough sent you, then answer some personal questions about Glough. He will ask how his wife is, select "'''Sadly his wife is no longer with us'''". He will then ask what his favourite dish is, select "'''Worm holes'''". Finally, he will ask for his new girlfriend's name, which is "'''Anita'''". {{Chat option|3Sadly his wife is no longer with us!|2He loves worm holes.|1Anita.}} You need to return to the Grand Tree to show the king the lumber order which is evidence of Glough's invasion plans, but Glough has ordered the guards not to let you in. You can now teleport out of the shipyard and head to the Gnome Stronghold, or leave via the charter ship if you brought coins. If you have completed the [[Tree Gnome Village]] quest, you can sneak in by using a [[spirit tree]], such as the one at the [[Grand Exchange]] or the [[Battlefield]]. Alternatively, talk to [[Femi]] by the gate to the stronghold. Tell her you need to get inside, and she will sneak you in. She will help you for free if you never entered the stronghold through the gate before, or if you chose to help her move boxes the first time you entered. If you chose not to help her when you first entered, she will charge you 1,000 coins. ===Tuzo=== {{Needed|[[Lumber order]]|skills={{SCP|Agility|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to climb the watchtower}} {{Map|x=2391|y=3511|r=3|width=220|height=220|align=left|caption=Anita's house on the map.|mtype=square}} [[File:The Grand Tree - Using the twigs.png|thumb|220px|Using the twigs on the pillars.]] After you show [[King Shareen|the king]] the [[Lumber order|note]] from the [[foreman]], he still will not believe your accusations, call you as paranoid as [[Glough]], and ask you to leave for your own safety. Speak to [[Charlie]] the prisoner again on the top floor of the [[Grand Tree]], who says he heard Glough mention a chest key that he left at his girlfriend [[Anita]]'s house. In the north-west corner of the stronghold, climb up the most north-western ladder by the tortoise pens to speak to [[Anita]] and she will give you [[Glough's key]] and ask you to return it to him. Go to Glough's house, and use the key to open the chest. Inside, you will find his [[invasion plans]] detailing his plan to seize control of [[Gielinor]]. '''Click continue''' to receive the plans. Ensure you have four free inventory spaces, then take the invasion plans to the king. He will still not believe you, stating that anyone could have made the plans. He will give you four bundles of [[twigs]], which was all his guards could find when searching Glough's house. Return to Glough's house, and climb up the watchtower. This tree is located on the east side of the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} by the chest and requires {{SCP|Agility|25}} to climb. Up in the watchtower, you will find a stone stand and four pillars. Use the twigs with the four pillars to spell out ''TUZO'', starting from the far left. Using the [[Translation book]], this translates to "open." After you have placed the twigs on the four pillars, you will hear gears turning, activating the trap door on this platform, '''but do not go in yet unless you are prepared for the fight.''' {{Clear|left}} ===Encountering the Black demon=== {{Needed|[[Combat]] [[equipment]] and [[food]] to last in a fight against a level 172 [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|Black demon]]}} [[File:Black demon (The Grand Tree, 1) safespot.png|thumb|250px|right|Safespot 1: The recommended safespot located directly north of the entrance ladder.]] Climb down the trapdoor into the cave below, and [[Glough]] will appear, threatening you with his plans to wipe out humans. '''Complete the conversation''' without interacting with anything else, or you will have to re-enter and repeat it. A level 172 [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|black demon]] will appear down the tunnel and immediately attack you. It can be fought with any combat style, but can be [[safespotted]] with [[Ranged]], [[Magic]] or a [[halberd]]. To safespot, immediately move one tile to the north and then east (adjacent to the ladder, see the picture). [[Magic]] is recommended, as the demon has a negative magic defence bonus. Use [[water spells]] if available to you as it has a 40% [[Elemental weakness|weakness]] to water spells. :'''Note:''' If the demon is not killed within 10 minutes, it will '''disappear''' and the battle needs to be '''restarted'''. To do so, walk through the tunnel and leave through the ladder next to [[King Narnode Shareen]], and re-enter Glough's trapdoor. :'''Note for 10HP pures:''' With [[Bind]], it is possible to kill the demon with a cannon with at least 120 cannonballs. When the scene begins, use Bind on the demon immediately and set up the cannon just 2-3 spaces west of the ladder you used to enter. If you die during setup the cannon will remain. You will know the cannon is in the right area if you can reload it from the ladder safespot. If the cannon aggros a rat during the fight without killing it, the cannon may stop firing, and you will need to take aggro from the demon by moving forward and back, or lure the rat away. ===The adamant king=== [[File:Daconia rock detail.png|left|70px]] After defeating the demon, Glough will flee into the tunnel behind him. Walk along the passage until you find [[King Shareen]] standing by a ladder. Talk to him and tell him that Glough sent a demon to attack you. Not believing you, he will finally send a guard to scout for Glough, finding him hiding amongst the stones. The king apologises, and asks you to locate the last [[Daconia rock]]. Ensure you have one free inventory space, then search the [[Root (The Grand Tree)|roots]] all around the area until you find the Daconia rock. It may be in any of the roots, so keep going until you have found the rock. '''Click continue''' once you find it or it won't appear in your inventory. If you somehow lose the rock, it'll spawn in the root where you first found it. Talk to King Shareen again for your reward for saving the Grand Tree. '''Congratulations, quest complete!''' ==Rewards== {{Quest rewards |name = The Grand Tree |image = [[File:The Grand Tree reward scroll.png|centre]] |qp = 5 |rewards = *{{SCP|Attack|18,400}} [[Attack]] [[experience]] *{{SCP|Agility|7,900}} [[Agility]] [[experience]] *{{SCP|Magic|2,150}} [[Magic]] [[experience]] *Access to the [[Grand Tree mine|mine]] under the [[Grand Tree]]. *Access to the [[Gnome glider]] transportation system. *Ability to use the [[Rocks (Tree Gnome Stronghold)|rocks]] as an [[Agility shortcut]] from the Grand Tree to the [[Barbarian Outpost]] (with 37 [[Agility]]). *Ability to use the spirit tree in the Stronghold after the completion of [[Tree Gnome Village]]. *Completing this quest awards the player with 5 [[Kudos]] which can be claimed by talking to [[Historian Minas]] in the [[Varrock Museum]]. Unlocks: * [[Black demon]] accessible in the [[Nightmare Zone]]. }} ==Required for completing== Completion of The Grand Tree is required for the following: *[[Monkey Madness I]] *[[The Eyes of Glouphrie]] ==Transcript== {{hastranscript|quest}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = Dialogue and quest progression in The Grand Tree quest has been improved. }} {{Subject changes |date = 25 April 2013 |update = Patch Notes (25 April 2013) |change = The Grand Tree showdown with the Black demon now works like a cutscene. }} {{Subject changes footer}} {{The Grand Tree}} {{DEFAULTSORT|Grand Tree, The}}

To repair it, he needs three [[planks]] for the tripod, a [[bronze bar]] for the tube, and [[molten glass]] for a new lens. Talk to him again '''three times''', and he will take each item from you. Once you give him the final item, he will mention you also need to retrieve a mould for the new lens that has been stolen by goblins. '''Make sure the professor has taken all of the items before continuing''', otherwise you will need to repeat the next section. ===Retrieving the lens mould=== {{Needed|recommended=An [[antipoison]] potion, energy potions, combat equipment (for lower levels) and food}} [[File:Goblin guard chathead.png|left|frameless]] :'''Note:''' If you don't have a form of [[antipoison]], you can pick up a [[superantipoison]] at a spawn in the corner of the south-eastern building near [[Greasycheeks]] and [[Smellytoes]]'s fire. Go down the stairs to the east of the reception room to find the [[Observatory Dungeon]] (the room with the stairs is directly east of the start point). Once down the stairs, you must find the [[goblin kitchen key]]. It is commonly found in the south-eastern most chest although it can vary from person to person. Search any chests you pass on the way to the south-eastern chest just in case. '''Once you search the correct chest, complete the dialogue or you won't receive the key'''. :'''Note:''' Sometimes there may be a [[poisonous spider]] (level 31) inside the chest. With the key, follow the north-eastern path west to the kitchen gate. "Prod" the [[Goblin guard|sleeping guard]] (level 42), who will wake and attack you. Kill him or get him stuck behind a wall and you will be able to pass through the gate. :'''Note:''' Getting him stuck will cause him to attack you again when you leave, and another sleeping goblin will spawn. Open the kitchen gate, consuming the key, and then inspect the [[goblin stove]]. You determine the goblins are cooking something foul in the [[lens mould]]. Dump out the stew and bring the mould back to the professor. [[File:Goblin stove (mould).png|right|frameless|200px]] After speaking to the professor, his assistant will interject and ask you to make the new lens yourself as the professor has a history of explosions when attempting to craft things. Use the molten glass that the professor just gave you with the lens mould to craft him a new [[observatory lens|lens]]. Give it back to the professor. He will want you to visit him in the Observatory. ===The Observatory=== [[File:Observatory.png|thumb|220px|The [[Observatory]]]] Climb back down the stairs into the [[Observatory Dungeon]]. Now follow the north-west passage (past the kitchen) to find some stairs leading to the [[Observatory]] (the southern set of stairs on the map). There is also a chest north-east of the stairs to the [[Observatory]], which spawns infinite [[Antipoison(1)|Antipoison(1)]] vials, which you can combine to make full vials. Go up the stairs, and a [[cutscene]] will play. If the cutscene does not play, you may have forgotten to give the finished lens to the professor. After the cutscene ends, go up the stairs and talk to the [[Observatory professor|professor]], and then "view" the telescope to see a constellation. '''Monkey Madness I''' is the fourth quest in the [[gnome quest series]], and one of the most well-known quests in ''RuneScape.'' The quest brings the player to [[Ape Atoll]], an island inhabited by civilised but unfriendly and high-level [[monkey]]s, in order to help [[Narnode Shareen]] track down his missing [[10th Squad]] military unit.

A grandmaster-difficulty sequel to the quest called [[Monkey Madness II]] was released on [[6 May]] [[2016]]. 

==Details==
{{Quest details

|startmap = 2466,3495
|difficulty = Master
|description = The King of the northern Gnomes, Narnode Shareen, is once again in need of your help. He recently decided to send an envoy of his Royal Guard, the 10th squad, to oversee the decommissioning of the Gnome owned ship-building facilities on the eastern coast of [[Karamja]].

It has been quite some time since the 10th squad were dispatched and they have been deemed missing in action. It will be up to you, should you decide to help, to find out what fate befell the 10th squad and if possible, track them down.

If only it were so simple. Sinister forces have begun to spread through the Gnome hierarchy and threaten to unleash an unknown terror upon the world. Far across the land, the fires of vengeance are being stoked once again. Can you unravel the mystery behind the deception? Can you separate the truth from the lies? Can you decide for yourself what is real and what is not?
|length = Long
|requirements = * Completion of the following quests:
** [[The Grand Tree]]
** [[Tree Gnome Village]]

==Introduction ==
[[File:Monkey Madness I - Ape Atoll map.png|thumb|400px|All the routes you'll need to take in the quest.]]

[[Ape Atoll]] is one of the most dangerous areas in the game. All native creatures other than the level 5 [[Bird|birds]] will be [[aggressive]] towards you, regardless of your [[combat level]], whenever you're not wearing the [[monkey greegree]] (made later in the quest). Players can hug the coasts of Ape Atoll when moving to avoid the poisonous snakes and spiders; some snakes may still be encountered this way, but players can simply wait for them to move.

When going to the island, make sure to bring plenty of [[food]], [[Antipoison|antipoison potions]], and an emergency [[teleport]], in addition to any other required items. Switching off [[Auto Retaliate|auto retaliate]] and utilising [[protection prayers]] will greatly improve your chances of survival.

At any point, you can teleport or flee from [[Ape Atoll]] to restock items without losing your progress. To leave the island by boat, simply talk to [[Lumdo]] in the landing area to go from Ape Atoll back to [[Crash Island]], and then talk to [[Waydar]] on Crash Island to go back to the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]]. To resume the quest, talk to [[Daero]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Grand Tree]] to go back to the hangar, talk to Waydar in the hangar to go back to Crash Island, and finally, talk to Lumdo on Crash Island to return to Ape Atoll.

== Monkey Business ==
{{Needed|three free inventory spaces|recommended=some high-healing [[food]], a form of [[Poison#Curing poison|poison protection]], a [[lockpick]], and a [[knife]] (to prevent the player from needing to bank by cutting the island's [[Pineapple plant|pineapple]] plants for food)}}

=== Chapter 1 ===
{{Listen
|title = [[New Chapter (Monkey Madness)|New Chapter]]
|align = right
|filename = New Chapter (Monkey Madness).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays upon starting a new chapter of the quest.}}
'''"In which our hero finds themself drawn back into Glough's web of deception and deceit."'''[[File:King Narnode Shareen chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Talk to [[King Narnode Shareen]] in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. He will tell you to investigate [[Glough]]'s old shipyard for any trace of the missing 10th Squad, and will give you the [[gnome royal seal]]. Bring this to [[Karamja]] (the ''"Gandius"'' option on the [[glider]] at the top of the [[Grand Tree]] will bring you nearby). ''If you do not have [[monkey bones]] (or a [[monkey corpse]]), kill a monkey while on Karamja to obtain some.''

'''Note: If you leave the quest to do something else, you will need the gnome royal seal to get into the shipyard'''

After arriving, enter the [[Shipyard (Karamja)|shipyard]] north of the glider landing site and speak with [[G.L.O. Caranock]], a gnome officer for the shipyard. He can be found in the building in the southern area, near the fence. He will act very suspiciously when spoken to, and advise you to return to the king.

Return to King Narnode, and he will give you [[Narnode's orders]] and tell you to speak to [[Daero]], the new head tree guardian. Daero can be found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the Grand Tree, near [[Blurberry Bar]]. Go through all the chat options with Daero, and ensure you're ready for surviving Ape Atoll; when you're ready, tell him you're prepared to leave. He will then blindfold you and take you to an [[Underground Military Glider Hangar|underground hangar]]. 

Talk to Daero in the hangar and he will introduce you to [[Waydar]], a gnome pilot. Waydar will task you with solving a "reinitialisation" puzzle, which is similar to the [[puzzle box]]es from [[Treasure Trails]]. If you have done these puzzles before, the sliding puzzle will be easy to complete; if not, see below for the solution, or bring 200,000 [[coins]] and go to [[Glough]], who resides in the same area he did during the [[Grand Tree]] quest. 

==== Waydar's puzzle ====
Begin solving the puzzle by clicking on the panel to the south-east by the southern glider. Players can take some [[spare controls]] from the nearby [[crate (Spare controls)|crate]] to view the solution, or simply consult the image below.

[[File:Monkey Madness I - Spare controls.png|thumb|220px|The solution to the reinitialisation puzzle.]]

Solve the sliding puzzle as follows (with the piece numbers counting from the top left corner, moving left to right):

{{Checklist|
* Manoeuvre pieces 1, 2, and 3 into their proper positions in the upper left corner.
* Position piece 4 in the upper right corner.
* Position piece 5 under piece 4 (shuffle pieces 4 and 5 around with some others if they are not in the right order).
* Slide piece 4 to the left and piece 5 up; the first row will now be done.
* Repeat this process with second and then third rows, leaving the completed rows intact.
* With rows 1-3 completed, the puzzle should now be solved in terms of 2-piece high columns.
* Position pieces 16 and 21 next to each other, in that order, on the right-hand side of the bottom row. Slide the remaining tiles clockwise to put them in place.
* Repeat this process with pieces 17 and 22, then with pieces 18 and 23.
* Pieces 19, 20, and 24 should now be easily moved to their correct places.
}}

After completing the puzzle, talk to Daero, and then Waydar. The two of you will depart and then land on the aptly named [[Crash Island]], where the 10th Squad also crashed earlier. Ask the nearby sailor [[Lumdo]] to bring you to [[Ape Atoll]], and he will refuse due to conflicting orders from his sergeant, [[Garkor]]; since Lumdo says he will not take orders from you, talk to Waydar again instead (watch out for poisonous [[Scorpion|scorpions]] just to his left, and '''do not''' click "Travel", as this will bring you back to the Grand Tree). After speaking with Waydar, speak with Lumdo once more, and he will now agree to take you to Ape Atoll.

Do not click the 'X' to close the story tablet that shows up after this conversation or it will cancel the subsequent cut-scene and you'll have to go through the chat option again.

===Chapter 2===
[[File:Monkey Madness I - Jail map.png|thumb|230px|The layout of the jail.]]
'''"In which our hero finds themselves engaging in severe quantities of monkey business."'''

====First Contact====
[[File:Aberab chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Once on the Atoll, start going west, sticking to the southern coastline until you reach a [[mahogany]] tree. From here, run north, avoiding the poisonous [[snake]]s, [[scorpion]]s, and [[Jungle spider (Ape Atoll)|jungle spider]]s. If you have the level to use it, activate [[Protect from Missiles]] as you travel north, as a volley of poisoned arrows will start pelting you as you come closer to the Ape Atoll gate. Once you get close enough to the entrance, you will be knocked out and placed in a prison.

After waking up, you will find yourself in a cell guarded by [[Trefaji]] and [[Aberab]], two gorilla guards. Speak to [[Lumo]], one of the captured 10th Squad members, and then prepare to make your escape.

==== Prison Break ====
{{Map:Monkey Mapness}}Throughout this section and any time you are re-jailed, you will need to stay one square away from the northern cell wall (near the patrolling guards' path) if the guards are in front of it. If you're in their range, they will punch you for 10-20 damage. The guards follow a path, which is as follows: one of the guards will patrol the area twice, walking the length of the prison each time, and then leave to rotate shifts. Use the time that the guard moves '''away''' from your [[Jail Door (Ape Atoll)|jail door]] to pick the lock. Once out, as the patrolling guard is walking out to switch with the one on standby, '''walk behind him to reach the exit.''' Be prepared to make several attempts.

After successfully making it out of the building, travel north of the jail and then east to find [[Karam]], an assassin and member of the 10th Squad. Karam can be found in the bushes near the crafting shop ([[File:Crafting shop icon.png]]); he is mostly translucent and he can be difficult to spot, so look carefully. After finding him, speak with him to learn about the gnome mage [[Zooknock]].

Refer to the map to the right for relevant locations during the quest. Be wary of all '''yellow''' dots, as they represent poisonous enemies (scorpions, snakes, and spiders), as well as aggressive monkey archers. When you are in the grass, the [[monkey archer]]s do not fire, but it's still a good idea to activate [[Protect from Missiles]] as a precaution.

Once you're ready, travel south, past the large door, while staying in the tall jungle grass. Past the door, go around the castle anti-clockwise until you're at the southern end, and from here, run south-east, until you are between a white building and the castle. To the east of that building is [[Garkor]], the Sergeant of the 10th Squad. Speak with him, and make sure to get all the way through the dialogue to the point where he tells you to go meet [[Zooknock]] in person.

==== Supply Crates ====
[[File:Monkey dentures detail.png|left|frameless|width=65x65]]Sprint west through the grass with Protect from Missiles on. Continue west (south of the buildings) in the grass until you reach the doorway to your north, marked on the map image above. Walk through the door to enter an enclosed area with a sleeping monkey guard, a [[Crate (banana)|banana crate]], and a [[Crate (monkey dentures)|dentures crate]].

When inside this house, '''stay on the dark brown ground along the walls''', or you'll risk being sent back to jail. The spiders inside are poisonous, but their poison only hits 1 damage, so it might be helpful to save your anti-poisons for later in the quest. There are bananas in the south-western crates next to the ladder if the player needs a source of food. 

From the entrance, head east and then north, and search the [[Crate (monkey dentures)|stacked crates]] towards the middle of the room to acquire [[monkey dentures]]. The sleeping guard is a non-threat so long as you don't talk to him; otherwise, he will call for guards. 

After you have the dentures, search the [[Crate_(Temple_of_Marimbo_Dungeon_entrance)|south-easternmost crate]] and a prompt will appear, asking if you're ready to enter the area below. You will take 32.9% of your current hitpoints as fall damage if you drop down into the cavern when entering, so heal up if necessary before attempting it to avoid dying to the poisonous spiders. Your [[Agility]] level has a chance to negate this damage, so a [[summer pie]] or other Agility boost may help avoid fall damage during this section.

Once inside the cavern, travel to the '''north-west''' part of the area and search the [[Crate (m'amulet mould)|crates]] to acquire the [[m'amulet mould]]. At this point, if you need to resupply, you can exit the city by going to the south-east corner of [[Marim]], running past the guards and the gravedigger, and climbing up the ladder. After climbing up, jump off the bridge, and go back to the boat to [[Crash Island]]. You can also teleport out.{{clear}}[[File:Monkey Madness I - M'amulet mould location.png|thumb|230px|The location of the M'amulet moulds.]]

====Amulet of Monkeyspeak====
{{Needed|the [[enchanted bar]], the [[m'amulet mould]], a [[ball of wool]], [[monkey corpse]] OR regular [[monkey bones]], and five free inventory slots for the bananas|recommended=1-2 [[antipoison]] potions, a one-click teleport, and some food.}}

'''''Note''': If you are going to do [[Recipe for Disaster]], bring a ranged or magic weapon to kill a monkey guard and archer to save time later. Low level Ironmen can use rune spear (kp) from Tai Bwo Wannai Trio if the healing is too much to handle.''
[[File:Zombie monkey (item) detail.png|left|frameless|width=85x85]]
After restocking, return to [[Ape Atoll]] and continue north-west until you are placed in the jail cell again. Escape the cell as before, then travel east towards the temple.

You must now descend through the [[trapdoor (Temple of Marimbo)|trapdoor]] to the east in the temple (see map). Activate [[Protect from Melee]] before entering the temple to block attacks from the powerful [[monkey guards]]. 

Most of the guards can simply be run through, but the ones with beards near the trapdoor will act as walls, trapping you if they surround you. The easiest method to get past the bearded gorillas is to go upstairs, and then climb down the ladder on the east side to get close to the trapdoor. If you choose to walk to the ladder directly, make sure to wait until the guards walk away; players can hide in the north-east corner of the temple until there is enough room to descend. If you're surrounded by guards and can't move, teleport out immediately; if you're trapped near the ladder, go up the stairs and hop worlds. Note that the ladder near the trap door can only be climbed up from the EAST side.
[[File:Wall of flame.png|thumb|width=429x429|The wall of flame.]]
Go down the trapdoor while still praying against melee. Ignore the [[monkey zombie]]s (or kill one and pick up the bones if you want to do [[Recipe for Disaster]] later), and swiftly use the [[enchanted bar]] on the nearby [[wall of flame]]s to make an unstrung [[M'speak amulet (unstrung)|monkey amulet]]. Either travel back up the ladder or find a [[safespot]] to get away from the foes, and use the [[ball of wool]] with the unstrung amulet to create the full [[m'speak amulet]]. Be aware that if you ascend the ladder, you will be attacked and can be trapped as before, so ensure Protect from Melee is active.

====A Monkey's Uncle====
[[File:Monkey talisman detail.png|left|frameless|width=85x85]]
Head to the building west of the jail, making sure to sneak through the grass. You'll see a banana garden that has a [[Monkey Child]] in it, which is being patrolled by [[The Monkey's Aunt]]. The aunt follows a predetermined path, which loops around the wooden house by the garden; do not enter the garden when the monkey's aunt is present, or she will call for guards to arrest you. Note that if you're caught, you can sometimes escape without being arrested by quickly climbing up the ladder in the building nearby before the monkeys reach you. Do not speak to [[The Monkey's Uncle]] upstairs, as he will also call the guards. You can use the abandoned building next to the banana garden to quickly access the garden, as it has a connecting corridor out of sight.

Wait for the aunt to walk away, then speak to the monkey child, and tell him that you are his uncle. After he reveals that he is supposed to collect 20 [[bananas]], search and pick five bananas from the nearby trees. The monkey cannot count, so you do not necessarily need 20, as long as you give him at least 5. Give him the bananas, then wait for a few moments in the corridor, and return to the monkey child when the aunt is away. Ask the child to lend you his [[monkey talisman]].

=====Multiple talismans=====
You can obtain more than one talisman without dropping your current ones, so be sure to get an additional talisman for each [[greegree]] you want (four in total are needed for all quests; see below). You will need to speak to the monkey child again for each one, telling him you have lost the talisman, which will cause him to cry. Waiting for the aunt to pass by the child again will make the monkey child have another talisman available; Alternatively, you can switch worlds to potentially make the process go faster. If you talk to the child again before the aunt has passed by, you will get the message "The monkey child is too busy crying..."

Note that after you make your first greegree, talismans can be purchased from [[Tutab's Magical Market]] for 1000 [[coins]]. Tutab will not open his shop unless you are in monkey form.

==== Making the greegrees ====
Once you have all of the required bones (or monkey corpse) and talismans, you must run through the tunnels again, bringing your items to Zooknock. Travel through the tunnel for a second time, and when you reach the end, '''use''' the [[monkey talisman]] and all monkey bones (or corpses) on [[Zooknock]].

After a brief delay and conversation, you will get a greegree corresponding to the bones you used on him. To make another greegree, you have to first talk to him again and ask him if he can make another. '''If you cancel the conversation accidentally, ask how to make the monkey talisman and it will resume.''' If for some reason this doesn't work, try the [[drop trick]] with your previous greegrees, and go through the dialogue again. After all desired greegrees are made, bank or stock up as needed, and return to [[Ape Atoll]].

===Chapter 3===
'''"In which our hero finds themself contending with life as a monkey."'''

{{Needed|[[Karamjan monkey greegree]], [[m'speak amulet]], 1 free inventory space, and a method of reaching [[Ardougne]]}}
[[File:Awowogei chathead.png|left|frameless]]
In this chapter, you will be required to speak with [[Awowogei|King Awowogei]] and retrieve a monkey from the [[Ardougne Zoo]]. If you need to bank or in order to be more efficient, '''you can skip to retrieving the monkey in Ardougne''' (section "Monkey See, Monkey Zoo" below), and then speak with Awowogei when you return to Ape Atoll (steps 1-3).

1- Wield the [[monkey greegree]] to become a monkey. In this form, you will not be approached or attacked by any of the monkeys or wildlife on the island, and you cannot engage in combat. As a Karamjan monkey, return to [[Garkor]] and speak with him. If you are transformed into a different kind of monkey, he'll tell you to change and come back. After you finish talking, with the m'speak amulet equipped, talk to the [[Elder Guard]] near Garkor. The guard will tell you to speak with [[Kruk]].

2- From the guard, run west until you pass the main gate into [[Marim]] and have reached the Western shore of Ape Atoll (do not exit the gate). Head slightly south and follow the ground path up the western hill, then climb up the bamboo ladder at the top and cross the bamboo bridge. Climb down the ladder on the east side and speak to Kruk. After the conversation ends, he will conveniently take you back to [[King Awowogei]].

3- Speak to Awowogei and offer an alliance, and he will ask you to rescue a monkey from the [[Ardougne Zoo]]. Teleport out and make your way to Ardougne.[[File:Monkey Madness I - G.L.O. and Awowogei.png|thumb|300x300px|Caranock, Waydar and King Awowogei plotting.]]

====Monkey See, Monkey Zoo====
Once in [[Ardougne]], ensure you have an empty inventory space and then head to the south-west corner and enter the zoo. Wield the [[greegree]] inside the zoo area to become a monkey, and then speak to the [[Monkey minder]], who will place you in the cage. Speak with a [[Monkey (Monkey Madness I)|monkey]] (the only one with a "Talk" option), and it'll hop into your inventory; then, unequip the greegree and speak to the Monkey minder again. He will be confused and let you out.

You will now need to travel '''by foot''' to the [[Gnome Stronghold]]. You cannot use any form of teleportation (including [[random events]], spirit trees and fairy rings), as doing so will remove the monkey from your inventory, requiring you to re-obtain it from the zoo. The [[canoe system]] will work, however.

Once in the [[Gnome Stronghold]], talk to [[Daero]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} to travel back to Ape Atoll as usual.

:''Extra: Your new monkey friend will supply you with some humorous dialogue, and examining him will get you poked. If you have any [[bananas]] in your inventory, he will most likely eat them. There is also a 1/256 chance that he will give you a [[clue scroll (medium)]] if you use bananas on him directly. These can be obtained conveniently from the trees in the [[Monkey Child]]'s garden or [[Solihib's Food Stall]]. Note that you must go through the entire dialogue. Only one clue may be obtained per player{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/707250010379952128|date=9 March 2016|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/101498|archivedate=30 May 2020|quote=1/256, and it's once only per player.}}.''

Once on Ape Atoll, equip your greegree and amulet to speak with Awowogei again. ''(If you have spoken before, simply speak to the Elder Guard to be let in; if not, refer to the section above).'' The monkey will automatically leave your backpack after speaking to Awowogei, and the king will consider an alliance.

Speak with Garkor to begin Chapter 4.

===Chapter 4, "The Final Battle"===
{{Needed|[[Greegree]], food, an antipoison, and [[combat equipment]] to defeat a level 195 [[Jungle Demon]]}}
[[File:Garkor chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Speak with Garkor one more time (as a human or monkey) to receive a [[10th squad sigil]]. '''''Do not equip it until you are ready for the final battle'''''. Make sure to hold onto the sigil, as if you lose it, Garkor will send you to [[Waymottin]] at the end of [[Zooknock]]'s tunnel to reclaim it.[[File:Monkey Madness I - Jungle Demon fight.png|thumb|350px|The 10th squad and the player fight the demon.]]

Bank in preparation for the [[Jungle Demon]] fight, and ensure you have full [[prayer points]] and health. When you are ready to fight, wear the sigil, and you will be promptly teleported to the Jungle Demon's arena.

'''note:'''
* You can wear the sigil, to start the fight, from anywhere in RuneScape; no need to return to Ape Atoll.
* Although you "wear" the sigil, it stays in your inventory and doesn't unequip your neck-slot equipment.
* Activate Protect from Magic '''''before''''' teleporting, and drink any necessary [[potions]].
* Switch to your weapon/unequip your greegree before teleporting. '''You will lose your greegree''' if you have it equipped and your inventory is full when you teleport.

Upon landing in the arena, you'll be confronted by a level 195 Jungle Demon which can hit up to 32 with both magic and melee. Protection prayers reduce all damage to zero; as such, if the player stands out of melee range, the fight can be completed by simply leaving on Protect from Magic and attacking the demon with Magic or Ranged. Note that the demon's melee attack can hit you even if you're two squares away, similar to a halberd; ensure you're three or more squares away to avoid it. Additionally, '''standing still''' once you are teleported to the arena will keep a distance between you and the Demon, who will not move until you do, although it will still attack you with Magic.

The 10th Squad gnomes will be nearby to assist with the fight, but '''you must deal the final blow to the demon yourself.''' If the gnomes deal the final strike, he will heal around 20 percent of his health (anywhere from 12%-25%); when the demon reaches 1 hitpoint, there will be a period where the gnomes stop attacking, so use this window to deal the final blow yourself.

The demon is weakest to Ranged, although Magic is fairly effective. Players should focus on their combat style with the highest damage. Note that the [[dwarf multicannon]] is effective against the demon, allowing [[pure]] accounts to kill him without gaining any [[Hitpoints]] experience; additionally, despite being from the jungle, he is not immune to poison. Melee is not recommended, but players looking to use melee combat will benefit from using rings of recoil, as the demon's melee attacks hit very accurately.
There is a [[safespot]] in the arena, across a bridge on the outside edge. When you run to the safespot, he will make his way to the bridge, but won't be able to fit over it. You may run further down the outside edge to stop him from attacking at all, allowing you to wait for the 10th Squad to weaken him, then returning to the bridge to deal the final blow.

If you die during the fight, the sigil can be reclaimed from Death's Office. No need to run through the Ape Atoll Dungeon.

==Trivia==
*[[Lumo]], [[Bunkdo]], and [[Carado]] will make a random comment each time the player is captured and thrown back into jail, with special dialogue upon being caught 10, 15, 20, 50, and 100 times. Additionally, the player will receive a [[stuffed monkey]] as a reward when being caught for the 100th time.
*If you talk to [[Zeke]], the scimitar seller of [[Al Kharid]], and ask him for a [[Dragon scimitar]], he will respond by saying, "The banana-brained nitwits who make them would never sell any to me. Seriously, you'll be a monkey's uncle before you hold a Dragon Scimitar," referencing when you pretend to be a monkey's uncle to obtain the [[monkey talisman]].
*If you have started [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]], completing this quest and receiving Daero's training unlocks a new [[fairy ring]] location in the [[Ape Atoll Agility Course|Ape Atoll agility course]]. This small area has two exits, one requires a [[ninja greegree]], as well as 48 [[Agility]] to continue through the remainder of the agility course. The other is a much slower route and crosses the nearby gorge by climbing the tower and crossing the rope bridge.
*If you wear a [[M'speak amulet]] and listen to the [[enchanted bar]], it says "I'm stuck in this horrible gold bar!"
*The chapter cards and cutscenes in this quest are references to the adventure game series ''{{Wp|Monkey Island}}''.
*Upon first talking to [[Awowogei]], [[Uwogo]] says to "never trust a northern monkey". This is about the friendly rivalry between the north and the south within the UK (Northern Monkeys, Southern Fairies).
*You can pick up the Karamjan monkey King Awowogei requests after bringing him to the island. If a player picks up the monkey delivered to King Awowogei after bringing him to the king, travels to Karamja by foot, and drops the monkey, the player will receive their level in Thieving experience multiplied by two.
*[[Karam]] seems to be a reference to Kalam Mekhar (a character from Steven Erikson's {{Wp|Malazan Book of the Fallen}}) and the 10th squad in general could be a reference to the Bridgeburners 9th squad from the same series.
*This entire quest was created by one intern at Jagex during a summer internship.
*If you give a monkey talisman back to the monkey child, he will be grateful and hug you.

Head to the [[Draynor Village]] marketplace and ask Martin the Master Gardener nearby if there is anything you can help with. He will mention that his roses haven't been doing as well as they used to. He suspects something's wrong, and wants you to ask several other members of the G.A.G. All of them will say that since recently they have troubles with their crops. However, the last gardener will suggest that the fairies might have something to do with it. '''Speak to''' [[Martin the Master Gardener|'''Martin''']] '''again''' and the player will suggest the last gardener might have the most accurate reasoning.

===Trouble in Zanaris===
{{Needed|[[Dramen staff]].|recommended=}}
[[File:Fairytale I - Growing Pains - Fairy Nuff's grotto.png|thumb|Fairy Nuff's room just north of the bank.]]
[[File:Fairy Godfather chathead.png|left]]
Travel to the fairy city of [[Zanaris]] via the shack in the middle of the [[Lumbridge Swamp]] with a [[Dramen staff]] equipped. Head to the [[Fairy Queen]]'s throne room, just south of where you enter the city. The "[[Fairy Godfather]]" has replaced the queen; ask where she is and he'll tell you that the queen has fallen to some sort of illness and is currently under the care of [[Fairy Nuff]]. Speak with this fairy in the north-west of the city. She'll give you details about the queen's illness and give you a [[symptoms list]] to take to a wizard named [[Zandar Horfyre]], in the [[Dark Wizards' Tower]].

===Investigating the illness===
{{Needed|[[Spade]] and the [[symptoms list]]|recommended=[[Falador teleport]] and a [[skills necklace]]}}

Travel to [[Falador]] and head west to reach the [[Dark Wizards' Tower]]. Climb up to the top floor and talk to [[Zandar]], who will take the symptom list and then suggest talking to [[Malignius Mortifer]] about killing the Tanglefoot. This necromancer can be found on the crossroads south of Falador. You can fast travel to him with a [[skills necklace]] (to the Crafting Guild).

He'll tell you he could probably help, but wants something from you first. He wants a [[Draynor skull|skull]] from a grave in the [[Draynor Manor]] backyard. Head to the back of the manor and dig up the grave there. In case you have no [[spade]], there is one inside the manor. If you have dug up the skull previously, you will not find it, and your character will mention that they think they stored it in the bank.

Head back to [[Zanaris]] with your [[magic secateurs]]. It is '''highly recommended''' to bank your [[Dramen staff]] at the Zanaris bank before the following fight, as you will need to obtain another one to return if you die here.

From the entrance to the city, travel south-west, past the [[agility shortcuts]], to the mysterious ruins of the [[Cosmic Altar]]. Climb through the gap on the west side of the room, and the [[Gatekeeper]] there will allow you to pass. Inside the tunnel are a few [[baby tanglefoot|baby tanglefootii]] (level 45). Proceed to the end of the tunnel to stumble upon the level 111 [[Tanglefoot]].

The Tanglefoot may only be damaged with the magic secateurs, and your maximum hit will depend on both your [[Strength]] and [[Farming]] levels. The Tanglefoot may be [[Flinching|flinched]] to avoid taking damage by standing one tile east of the southern end of the corridor, attacking then returning to the eastern tile until his health bar disappears. [[Protect from Melee]] is highly recommended if not flinching.

:'''Tip:''' If a baby tanglefoot walks onto the player's safespot, those with RuneLite may consider using the Menu Entry Swapper plugin, swapping the Attack option for BOTH baby tanglefoot (there are two kinds) to prevent the player from accidentally attacking them.

Once defeated, the Tanglefoot will drop the [[Queen's secateurs]]. '''Pick up the secateurs''' and return them to the [[Fairy Godfather]].

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
